data.body: Epic close blocked by plan-review (re-run at current sha): critical G6 finding — the epic plan overclaimed recall; the COMMITTED high-precision tier deliberately does NOT fire on the modal unlocked-twin class (git rm+commit; getmtime+remove on index.lock), which carry no committed sync token — portable recall there comes only from the PROJECT noisy tier. This is exactly the shipped two-tier design. Addressed via the reviewer's offered documentation path: added an explicit 'Recall boundary (committed vs project tier)' reconciliation to the Approach and aligned AC#2 to name the committed-vs-project token coverage split. Re-running epic review-plan.
